messages:
kai: Quick PR to add a small 'provision-to-prod' checklist for Dedicated capacity. It includes a rwctl walkthrough, TF snippets, and a short paragraph on autoscale fallback behavior. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/handbook/pull/721

marie: Love the checklist. Request: add an explicit step to run `rwctl reserved validate --pool-id` after provisioning, and show expected output. Many folks skip verification.

kai: Good call. I'll add the command and sample output. Also planning to include a brief SDK (python) example showing scale_policy TTL and eviction policy. @infra-eng do you want to propose recommended defaults?

infra-eng: Recommend: min_replicas=1, max_replicas=6 for general workloads; autoscale cooldown 60s; preemption_policy default 'opportunistic'. I'll paste a one-line TF example and a note about label keys.

docs-bot: Link-checker: /handbook/dedicated/old-cli -> 404. Suggested replacement: /handbook/cli/rwctl-overview

marie: Also can we be explicit about isolation labels being mandatory for reserved pools? Add a short clause: pools without tenant labels will be rejected by the API. That avoids confusion seen from onboarding tickets.

infra-eng: Adding TF sample:
```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "default" {
  name = "batch-worker"
  gpu_type = "a10g"
  capacity = 2
  preemption_policy = "opportunistic"
  isolation_labels = { tenant_id = "team-xyz" }
}
```

kai: Added python snippet and CLI validate step. Python snippet:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
pool = c.reserved.create(name='batch', gpu_type='a10g', scale_policy={'min':1,'max':6})
print(pool.id)
```

sre-ops: For SLA wording: reserved pools are covered by 99.9% control-plane availability. Call out that fallback to shared increases latency and token cost; include link to SRE runbook for exact metric names. I'll provide the metric IDs.

marie: Tiny nit: change 'TTL' to 'cooldown' in the snippet wording. Otherwise LGTM.

kai: Updated and pushed. Will wait for CI link-check pass then merge. Thanks! :rocket:
